correctness.rationale: For dim H>=2 the antilinear quadratic form reduces to B=(A+A#)/2=JQ, Q positive and J commuting conjugation. Frame sums are bounded by positive Ky Fan sums; J-fixed high spectral vectors attain their suprema in the limit. With threshold sigma_k, equality in the positive trace bound occurs precisely when the spectral projection onto [sigma_k,infinity) has dimension at least k. The complex Stiefel frame space is path connected and the image rotation invariant; explicit isotropic frames for all finite parities and recursive infinite-dimensional isotropic vectors include zero. Hence no radius is omitted below the supremum. Consecutive differences recover all generalized singular values and yield compactness/Schatten tests. A 5,580-assertion reproducible numerical checker supplements but does not prove the infinite theorem. Boundary and dimension-one exclusions are explicit.
